# BaseJobQueue.options property

The options this queue was constructed with, kept so that accessors like [BaseJobQueue.name](/api/job/latest/job.basejobqueue.name/) can read them back. Treat as read-only — nothing re-reads them after the broker connection is made, so changing one here has no effect on a running queue.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected options: JobQueueOptions;
```
